🌸 ESP32-C6 Botanical Terrarium

Deskflower Web Flasher

Flash the complete Deskflower firmware to your Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47 with one click directly from your browser.

Target Device: Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47 (ST7789 172×320 IPS)
⚠️ Web Serial is not supported in this browser. Please use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge. ⚠️ Web Serial requires a secure (HTTPS or localhost) connection.
1
Connect your ESP32-C6 board to your computer via USB-C.
2
Click Install Deskflower and select the USB Serial port from the popup list.
3
Wait ~30 seconds for the flash to complete. Your Deskflower will boot immediately!

🎮 Controls & Gestures

  • Single Click: Water plant (+22% hydration)
  • Double Click: Mutate to next generation
  • Hold (> 2s): Launch Wi-Fi Setup Portal

✨ Core Features

  • Wi-Fi 6: SoftAP captive setup at 192.168.4.1
  • Atmosphere: 5 diurnal time-of-day palettes
  • Weather: Real-time Open-Meteo sync
  • Memory: LittleFS state persistence
